note: An index into docs/DECISION-*.md, not a second record. The document is authoritative; every string here except rejected[].alternative must appear verbatim in the document it is attributed to, and tests/test_decision_graph.py fails otherwise. Questions are not stored here: they are derived from docs/research_question_registry.json.

statuses.ADOPTED: in force; the document records it as implemented or effective
statuses.WITHDRAWN: reversed by its own record; kept because a correction is part of the record
statuses.PENDING: decided and not in force; the document says so
